about: #2616, #2783: production's text, measured on production's answers with this checkout's server. Written by test/text-bound-live.mjs --record, this about included (text-bound.mjs RECORD_ABOUT). tools: the production-wide tools (exposure_radar, cve_summary), held to MARGIN from this record, their answers kept in fixtures/prod-answers/ (written only from scripts/probe-prod.sh); answers_kept says so. cases: each case of text-bound.mjs SHAPED measured on production, held to the ceiling, and text-bound.test.mjs holds each SHAPED case's text, and (#3273) its structured result, within SHAPED_DRIFT of its record here (STRUCTURED_DRIFT_KNOWN names the cases past it, and what clears each); source says where the answers came from (probe-prod, the answers kept here, the hosted endpoint, replayed, or for exposure_radar and cve_intel the hosted endpoint's own text). Dates (#2782): measured_at is when production was read for the number, and read_ms how long that read took (null where it was not recorded); a re-measure of the kept answers (--answers test/fixtures/prod-answers --record) moves neither. answers_age_ms is how old each kept answer was, by its own generated_at, when production was read, written by the read: the API serves a radar's aggregate stale past its 60 s cache TTL to the first request after it, and the CDN 300 s more, so an honest read's answers can be minutes old; text-bound.test.mjs fails when measured_at less a kept answer's generated_at is not the age the read recorded for it. answers_read_at (#2822) is when the kept answers were read, the same read. code_measured_at is when this checkout's server last measured the answers, and code_version which code that was: package.json's version, with +unreleased when CHANGELOG.md's newest section is unreleased; package_version is package.json's version alone. total and blocks: the text's characters, all blocks and each. structured (#3013): the answer's structuredContent as compact JSON, what Claude Code hands the model, held to STRUCTURED_BUDGET (30,000); a case recorded before 3.0.0 carries none. data_truncated and truncated (#3273): whether the server measured cut that structured result's data, and what it cut, so the cut level is on record, not inferred; a case recorded before carries neither.
